title: Administration announces new tariffs on 14 trading partners over industrial overcapacity
detail: Per a Google News-aggregated report, the Trump administration announced new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China, Japan, Singapore and some EU members, citing industrial overcapacity. The proposal reportedly retains a 15% cap for Korea, Japan and the EU. The EU rejected the case for the tariffs. Rates and effective dates not confirmed in the feed.
